findings.title: Exclusive lock held across slow I/O with no re-check
findings.body: In pkg/api/webassets/webassets.go GetWebAssets takes entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock() and then does readWebAssetsFromCDN (network) and readWebAssetsFromFile (disk) while still holding it, and never re-checks the cache after acquiring the write lock. This means every cache miss serializes all other callers, including fast-path cache hits that only need RLock, behind file/network latency, and N concurrent missers will each reload sequentially (thundering herd) instead of one winner populating the cache. Fix with double-checked locking and load outside the critical section: RLock check, unlock, load, then Lock only to publish (with a second check for non-Dev mode).
